description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade and image check functions for different hardware boards within the OpenWrt build system, specifically for the Mediatek MT7622 platform.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade based on the board type, calling specific upgrade functions for various hardware models.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image for the current board type.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration to emmc for specific boards during upgrade.
